name: agent-manager.supervision-observation-read
purpose: Project one bounded Agent Manager owner observation into selected supervision evidence without rereading the board or transcripts.

owner_observation.description: One owner-produced EffortDiscovery join containing selected effort rows and references.

selected_effort_refs.description: The exact effort references selected for this wake; at most 16.

assumptions: Agent Manager owns the supplied observation and its detail references.
The observation contains bounded metadata and references, never transcript bodies or credentials.
invariants: Read-only finite projection; no owner calls, inference, launches, assessments or promotions.
Selection is exact and order-preserving; missing selected rows remain explicit uncertainty.
Prior assessment, changed evidence, usage, named waits and typed repair links remain joined with detail references.
The output is bounded to 16 selected rows and 32 total detail references.

signals.summary: Selected compact owner rows and their bounded detail references
